_comment: Budgets of je-bench-jobs and je-bench-memory (docs/specs/S06-jobs-memory.md R23-R26), je-bench-diag (S28 R26) and je-bench-particles (docs/specs/S20-particles.md R20-R26, AC10-AC12), measured with min(8, hardware threads - 2) workers on the build server's Linux x64 Release build. check_bench.py fails on a miss.

submit_throughput_jobs_per_s.spec: R23 empty-job submit+execute from one producer

submit_round_trip_p99_us.spec: R23 submit + wait on an idle pool, p99

parallel_for_speedup_ratio.spec: R24 parallelFor over 1M units of ~1us: speedup / (workers+1)

nested_parallel_for_speedup_ratio.spec: R24 nested 64x64 from 8 worker jobs: speedup / (workers+1)

frame_protection_p99_ms.spec: R25 High parallelFor of 8x1ms under 200 Heavy 20ms jobs, p99

heartbeat_ns.spec: S28 R26 diag::heartbeat(), median of 9 runs

ring_write_120b_ns.spec: S28 R26 a 120-byte crash-ring write (memcpy included), median of 9 runs

install_ms.spec: S28 R26 diag::crash::install on an empty report root

watchdog_idle_cpu_pct.spec: S28 R26 the hang watchdog's polls with the main thread idle, % of one core over 5 s

range_allocator_alloc_free_p99_ns.spec: R26 RangeAllocator allocate+free with 10k live ranges, p99

stats_and_hooks_overhead_pct.spec: R26 stats per job, one thread (bounds the share of R23), median of 41 paired trials

ref_100k_bytes_per_particle.spec: R20 channel storage per particle of the reference stack

ref_100k_sim_8w_projected_ms.spec: R21 reference stack, 100k live, per tick, 8 workers (1 thread / (9 x 0.6))

ref_100k_nonoise_sim_8w_projected_ms.spec: R21 without Noise, 8 workers (1 thread / (9 x 0.6))

ref_100k_prep_8w_projected_ms.spec: R22 render prep of 100k for a view, 8 workers (1 thread / (9 x 0.6))

ref_100k_sort_extra_1t_ms.spec: R22 a sorted view's extra cost at 100k (1 thread)

ref_100k_simd_speedup.spec: R24 SIMD against scalar, the reference tick, 1 thread

noise_simd_speedup.spec: R24 SIMD against scalar, the Noise kernel

collision_world_10k_rays_per_tick.spec: AC5 World collision at Medium quality: <= 256 queries per tick

culled_emitter_us.spec: AC10 an off-screen Automatic emitter's frame cost

empty_scheduler_us.spec: R26/AC12 the particle scheduler of a scene without systems
